dialogues.speaker: Sibu
dialogues.text: Naturally, someone like me who delivers letters all the time has seen a lot more of the world than someone who never gets out.

dialogues.speaker: Sibu
dialogues.text: But I mainly carry messages from tribe to tribe, so I'm a lot less well-traveled if you compare me to those of my colleagues who've been much further afield.

dialogues.speaker: Sibu
dialogues.text: I even have a friend who once delivered something near Ochkanatlan!

dialogues.speaker: Sibu
dialogues.text: It's an ancient city, built by the followers of the first Pyro Archon. The whole area's very dangerous, but we'll deliver there all the same!

dialogues.speaker: Sibu
dialogues.text: I just hope I'll be lucky enough to pick up a cool commission like that too sometime soon...
